Population increased in Carmarthenshire

The estimated population of Carmarthenshire in 2024 was 190,800 usual residents, a rise of 0.2% since 2023.

This meant that Carmarthenshire's rate of population change placed it among the slowest growing 20 percent of local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Carmarthenshire increased by 1.4%.

Over this slightly longer period, Carmarthenshire was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Carmarthenshire

The average (median) age stayed at 46.9 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Carmarthenshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Carmarthenshire is an area that is classed as intermediate rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Carmarthenshire's population of 190,800 usual residents was made up of:

  • 31,854 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.7%)
  • 111,055 people aged 16 to 64 years, (58.2%)
  • 47,891 people aged 65 years and over, (25.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Carmarthenshire has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (25.1% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Carmarthenshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from births and deaths.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Carmarthenshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Carmarthenshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 831 people (-0.4%). In total, there were 1,538 births and 2,369 deaths in Carmarthenshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 782 (0.4%). There were 6,107 people entering the area and 5,325 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Carmarthenshire's population of 467 (0.2%) as a result of 844 people entering the area and 377 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Carmarthenshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Carmarthenshire in mid-2023 is 190,381.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 240 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 58 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 298 people.
